worldcombat.skill.swift.summary: A ring of star-shaped rays bursts out and each star curves after a different foe, so it never misses; scatter them across enemies or concentrate them all on the target.
worldcombat.skill.swift.description.0: Each star deals %1$s damage; %2$s stars burst out at once.
worldcombat.skill.swift.description.1: A star turns up to %1$s degrees per tick and flies at %2$s blocks per tick, locking foes within %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.swift.description.2: Each star has a %1$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.swift.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.swift.preference.scatt: On: stars spread across every foe in range, covering more, but the chosen target takes fewer stars, with 2 ticks more windup and 3 ticks more cooldown. Off: every star rushes the chosen target, heavier and faster on one.
worldcombat.skill.swift.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of firing. Larger values open up further.
worldcombat.skill.swift.preference.ai.sp: On: firing jumps in priority when another foe stands near the target, so the scatter catches both. Off: order it like a plain ranged attack.
worldcombat.skill.swift.preference.ai.le: On: the user may leave its post to find a line of fire; off: it only fires from where it stands.
